title: Earthly Tunisian Sun Dried Tomatoes Tagine
description: A sour and cozy Tunisian dish featuring sun dried tomatoes and lardons render, this vegetarian friendly tagine is perfect for a chilly evening, its glassy jelly texture will leave you wanting more.

ingredients.name: sun dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lardons and cook until they are crispy, then remove them from the pot with a slotted spoon.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chopped sun dried tomatoes, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the lardons to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Serve the tagine warm, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
